description: This Java source file defines the HL7InQueueProcessor class, which manages processing of HL7 message queues in the OpenMRS healthcare software. It handles identifying, processing, and moving messages within the HL7 inbound queue, with thread-safe execution and integration with OpenMRS services.

classes.name: HL7InQueueProcessor
classes.description: Java class responsible for processing HL7 inbound queue messages, managing concurrency, and invoking HL7 services within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.description: Static method to set the processing count.

methods.name: processHL7InQueue
methods.description: Processes a single HL7InQueue item, with error handling and memory cleanup.

methods.name: processNextHL7InQueue
methods.description: Retrieves and processes the next queued HL7 message, returning true if processed.

methods.name: processHL7InQueue
methods.description: Begins processing all HL7InQueue entries in a separate thread, ensuring only one runs at a time.
